definition: דּוּר noun [masculine] circle, ball — 1. circle : Du Isa 29:3 thinks noun here also is כַּדּוּר (or כִּדּוֺר ) = כִּידוֺר onset of combatants ; Marti כְּדָוִד as ᵐ5 Lo Brd and others; וְחָנִיתִי כַּדּוּר עליך Isa 29:3 ( > ᵐ5 Brd כְּדָוִד ). 2. ball צָנוֺף יִצְנָפְךָ צְנֵפָה כַּדּוּר Isa 22:18 (so most; but Bö NÄ ii. 134 De Or Jastr PAOS 1888, xciv ff. regard noun as כַּדּוּר , ball , as Talmud, compare also MV SS under the word; see כדר ). [ 3. heap, pile Ezek 24:5 Thes Ke MV compare מְדוּרָה v Ezek 24:9 but see above below דּוּר verb ]

דּוּר noun [masculine] circle, ball —

1. circle: DuIsa 29:3 thinks noun here also is כַּדּוּר (or כִּדּוֺר) = כִּידוֺר onset of combatants; Marti כְּדָוִד as ᵐ5 Lo Brd and others; וְחָנִיתִי כַּדּוּר עליך Isa 29:3 ( > ᵐ5 Brd כְּדָוִד).
2. ball צָנוֺף יִצְנָפְךָ צְנֵפָה כַּדּוּר Isa 22:18 (so most; but BöNÄ ii. 134 De Or JastrPAOS 1888, xciv ff. regard noun as כַּדּוּר, ball, as Talmud, compare also MV SS under the word; see כדר). [
3. heap, pile Ezek 24:5 Thes Ke MV compare מְדוּרָה vEzek 24:9 but see above below דּוּר verb]
